The '''ZeHeth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[ZeHeth/Legends|ZeHeth]].
